_about: TODO-30 turn 7 (AB-7 / AB-9): versioned ambient manifest for run_seeds.py --manifest. Same schema as manifest.json; kind cli runs montecarlo ambient-gate on a complete clone of the request with Seed replaced, RepoRoot set by the driver (repo_root), and the family's overrides. Protocol: gate_selection (F128[1:65], null acquisitions only) -> select_thresholds.py writes gate-thresholds-v1.json -> its SHA-256 is pinned in gate_validation's overrides -> gate_validation (O128[0:128], null + source acquisitions) -> aggregate_gate.py. Selection and validation seed sets are disjoint (F128[0] = 12345 = O128[0] is skipped by seed_offset 1). The validation family is the EV-07 / EV-09 ambient re-measurement (N = 128, as family noise).

families.evidence: AB-7 threshold selection: 64 seeds x 64 background-only acquisitions per configuration (4096)
AB-7 validation (128 x 16 = 2048 background-only acquisitions per configuration) and the EV-07 / EV-09 count gates under ambient background (300 repeats per condition)
